faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about using the Rail Madad platform.
faqPage.q1: What is Rail Madad Grievance Portal?
faqPage.a1: Rail Madad is the official Grievance Redressal Mechanism of the Ministry of Railways, Government of India. It integrates all passenger grievance systems into a single platform for faster resolution.
faqPage.a2: Any passenger holding a valid PNR or UTS ticket, or any citizen using railway facilities, can register a grievance through this portal.
faqPage.q3: How do I file a grievance?
faqPage.a3: You can file a grievance by clicking on "File Complaint", entering your 10-digit PNR, selecting the appropriate category, and providing a description. You can also attach photos or audio clips as evidence.
faqPage.q4: How can I track the status of my complaint?
faqPage.a4: You can use the "Track Complaint" option on the home page or navigate to the "My Complaints" section in your citizen dashboard. You will also receive SMS updates on your registered mobile number.
faqPage.q5: What should I do if my grievance is not resolved?
faqPage.a5: If a grievance is closed without satisfactory resolution, you may reopen it within 72 hours through the "My Complaints" section or by calling the Railway Helpline at 139.
faqPage.q6: What is the procedure for medical emergencies?
faqPage.a6: For immediate medical assistance on trains or at stations, please use the "Medical Emergency" option while filing a complaint or directly call the Railway Helpline 139 for expedited support.
faqPage.q7: How do I report a security threat?
faqPage.a7: Security threats, theft, or harassment should be reported immediately under the "Security" category. The RPF (Railway Protection Force) is immediately notified for such incidents.

privacyPage.title: Data Protection & Privacy
privacyPage.p1: Rail Madad collects personal information such as Name, PNR number, Mobile Number, and Email Address during the registration and grievance filing process. We also collect media files (photos, audio) that you choose to upload as evidence. This data is strictly used for the purpose of grievance redressal.
privacyPage.p2: The information provided is utilized by the Ministry of Railways and relevant Divisional authorities to investigate, track, and resolve your complaints. Anonymized data may be used for statistical analysis to improve railway services and infrastructure.
privacyPage.p3: Your personal data is handled with strict confidentiality. It is only shared with the concerned railway officials required to resolve the issue. We do not sell or distribute citizen data to third-party commercial entities. All data is securely hosted on servers managed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) and protected by industry-standard encryption.
privacyPage.p4: If granted permission, Rail Madad may collect your device's geographical location to auto-detect the nearest railway station or to assist emergency response teams (RPF/Medical) in reaching you faster. You may revoke this permission at any time via your device settings.
privacyPage.disclaimer: By using the Rail Madad Grievance Portal, you consent to the collection and use of your information as outlined in this policy under the guidelines of the IT Act, 2000 (Government of India).
